name: contrast-lab
title: Contrast Lab
description: Check color contrast with WCAG 2 and APCA. Live preview, a one-tap nearest-passing fix, and HEX, RGB, HSL, and OKLCH input.
author: fracazo

commands.name: check-contrast
commands.title: Check Contrast
commands.subtitle: Contrast Lab
commands.description: Check WCAG 2 and APCA contrast and suggest a passing color.
